#include <string>
#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int N;
    string Str;
    cin >> N >> Str;

    int count = 0, par = 0, wordInPar = 0, max_length = 0;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < Str.length(); i++) {
        char c = Str[i];
        if (c == '_') {
            if (par == 0) {
                max_length = max(max_length, count);
            } else if (count > 0) {
                wordInPar++;
            }
            count = 0;
        } else if (c == '(') {
            par = 1;
            max_length = max(max_length, count);
            count = 0;
        } else if (c == ')') {
            par = 0;
            if (count > 0) {
                wordInPar++;
            }
            count = 0;
        } else {
            count++;
        }
        if (par == 0) {
            max_length = max(max_length, count);
        }
    }
    cout << max_length << " " << wordInPar << "\n";
    return 0;
}
